title: Lens
description: Draw the area where two circles overlap as white on a black background. Both circles have radius 0.55. One is centered at (-0.25, 0.0) and the other at (0.25, 0.0). Only the lens-shaped overlap is white. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: Build each circle's distance, length(uv - center) - radius. A point is in the overlap only if it is inside both, so keep the larger of the two distances with max().
